title: Programmable nonlinear function synthesis on a photonic processor with quantum signal processing
summary: Programmable photonic integrated circuits are emerging as increasingly large and versatile interferometric processors operating at room temperature. However, their native operations are linear, while many computational tasks require nonlinear input-output transformations that typically rely on nonlinear optical materials or resonant devices. Here, we establish a direct mapping between quantum signal processing (QSP) and the native two-mode operations of programmable interferometric photonic integrated circuits, showing that the $SU(2)$ structure required by QSP can be realized through…
